name: Drift Report
summary: A weather chart 404 page: sonde 404 drifted off the map, so you fly a new balloon to a station that works
about: A full not-found page for a weather service, drawn as a live chart with isobars, cold and warm fronts, station symbols and wind that flows across the map and swirls around your pointer. Plot a course and a balloon climbs from Home base, bursts at altitude, opens its parachute and lands on the station you picked, stamped Recovered with a link.
how: The isobars draw themselves while sonde 404 drifts along its track and off the edge of the chart
Type in Plot a course and press Launch, or pick a station from the list; every station on the map is a link
Watch the telemetry climb, the balloon burst and the parachute land it with a Recovered stamp
Press Release a spare balloon and blow it toward a station with your pointer to land it there
It plays a short demo by itself until you click or type; the theme button turns it into a night radar screen
